_comment: Channel registry. One entry per publishing destination. The generator allocates topics per channel, the compliance gate enforces cross-channel uniqueness, and render-batch routes each upload to the right adapter.
_cross_channel_warning: Publishing the same or near-identical video to two channels is a mass-produced content risk across the whole estate, not just within one channel. The gate blocks it. Give each channel its own niches.

channels.notes: Primary channel. The daily-shorts workflow publishes here.
Enable once YT2_REFRESH_TOKEN, YT2_CLIENT_ID, YT2_CLIENT_SECRET and YT2_OAUTH_CLIENT_JSON are set. Deliberately different niches from yt-bbmw0 so the two channels never compete or look duplicated.
